# Anode

> Anode Research designs decision systems, incentives, and coordination for ambitious networks and communities.

Anode helps groups turn many perspectives into coherent action. Its practice combines fieldwork, discourse analysis, and mechanism design to create roles, rules, rewards, and feedback systems that teams can operate.

## Core areas

- Decision systems: roles, delegation, voting, and escalation designed to put decisions in the right hands.
- Incentive design: compensation and recognition systems designed around long-term value and tested against gaming.
- Coordination architecture: trusted units, mandates, and interfaces that help networks scale while preserving useful signals.
- Governance research: empirical study of participation, expertise, attention, delegation, and collective intelligence.

## Primary page

- [Anode — Better systems for collective action](https://www.anode.gg/): An overview of Anode's thesis, practice, research record, and method.

## Practice pages

- [Decision systems](https://www.anode.gg/decision-systems/): Roles, delegation, voting, and escalation designed to put each decision in the right hands.
- [Incentive design](https://www.anode.gg/incentive-design/): Rewards and recognition designed around durable value and tested against gaming.
- [Coordination architecture](https://www.anode.gg/coordination-architecture/): Trusted units, mandates, interfaces, and feedback loops for adaptive networks.

## Research

- [The DAO Delegation Handbook](https://www.anode.gg/research/dao-delegation-handbook/): Handbook 002 by Enrique Alles Fernandez, V2 / September 2026. An overview, chapter guide and original PDF on delegated governance authority, mandates, incentives, revocation and a practical architecture canvas.

- [Research index](https://www.anode.gg/research/): Fieldwork, discourse analysis, and mechanism design across governance and networked organizations.
- [Comparative governance research](https://www.anode.gg/research/comparative-governance/): A study of governance behavior across 15 DAOs, grounded in 59K forum posts and 4.8K mapped threads, with a five-pass analysis protocol, evidence matrix, interpretation limits, and citation-ready summary.
- [About Anode](https://www.anode.gg/about/): Anode Research's approach, principles, and contact details.
